article_title: Endometriosis centres 'at risk' of closure as women's health 'broken'

tasks.prompt: What is the central issue examined in the article?
options: Whether all endometriosis treatment should move permanently to private hospitals
Why Wales no longer recognises endometriosis as a chronic condition
How shortages of dedicated staff, theatre time and funding threaten accredited specialist endometriosis care in Wales
Why accreditation rules require patients to undergo nine operations
tasks.correct_answer: How shortages of dedicated staff, theatre time and funding threaten accredited specialist endometriosis care in Wales
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מתמקדת במחסור במשאבים ובצוותים רב־תחומיים שמסכן את ההסמכה והקיימות של מרכזי האנדומטריוזיס בוויילס.

tasks.prompt: Why was Kelly O'Shea's last operation stopped after about 45 minutes?
options: She chose to leave the hospital.
The required bowel surgeon was unavailable.
Her symptoms had completely disappeared.
The centre had already lost accreditation.
tasks.correct_answer: The required bowel surgeon was unavailable.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: האבחנה של קלי מערבת גם את המעי, אך לאחר שהורדמה התברר שמנתח המעי הנדרש אינו זמין ולכן הטיפול לא בוצע.

tasks.prompt: What does “in jeopardy” mean when describing the specialist centres?
options: Working at full capacity
Likely to receive more funding
At risk of serious harm, downgrading or closure
Already transferred to England
tasks.correct_answer: At risk of serious harm, downgrading or closure
tasks.explanation_hebrew: in jeopardy פירושו בסכנה; המרכזים עלולים לא לעמוד בדרישות, לאבד הסמכה ולהצטמצם או להיסגר.

tasks.prompt: What must accredited centres provide for complex endometriosis care?
options: Only a GP and an emergency nurse
A private surgeon chosen by each patient
One annual clinic without specialist support
Named multidisciplinary specialists with dedicated time, including gynaecologists, nurses, colorectal surgeons, urologists and radiologists
tasks.correct_answer: Named multidisciplinary specialists with dedicated time, including gynaecologists, nurses, colorectal surgeons, urologists and radiologists
tasks.explanation_hebrew: דרישות ההסמכה כוללות צוות רב־תחומי מוגדר עם זמן ייעודי: גינקולוגים, אחיות מומחיות, מנתחי מעי, אורולוגים ורדיולוגים.

tasks.prompt: Why could losing BSGE accreditation increase costs for NHS Wales?
options: Patients with complex cases could be sent to England for more expensive care.
Every GP would need to become a surgeon.
Private hospitals would stop treating endometriosis.
Accreditation automatically pays patients £20,000.
tasks.correct_answer: Patients with complex cases could be sent to England for more expensive care.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ללא מרכזים מוסמכים בוויילס, מטופלות יישלחו לאנגליה, והכתבה מציינת שטיפול כזה יעלה יותר ל־NHS Wales.

tasks.prompt: In the article, what does relying on staff “goodwill” suggest?
options: The required specialists are formally scheduled and funded.
The service depends on professionals helping without protected, planned time in the rota.
Patients are guaranteed shorter waiting lists.
Accreditation standards no longer apply.
tasks.correct_answer: The service depends on professionals helping without protected, planned time in the rota.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: goodwill מצביע על הסתמכות על נכונות אישית של אנשי מקצוע לסייע, במקום הקצאת זמן קבועה ומתוקצבת במסגרת השירות.

tasks.prompt: How have resource problems affected Kelly O'Shea's treatment and life?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין לפחות ארבעה פרטים: ניתוחים שלא הושלמו, כאב כרוני, רקמת צלקת, המתנה אפשרית של שנתיים, אובדן אמון ותשלום פרטי של 20 אלף ליש״ט.
expected_points: Required specialists or sufficient theatre time were unavailable during operations.
Her endometriosis was left untreated despite repeated surgery, adding scar tissue.
She has lived with daily pain for about three and a half years and put major parts of life on hold.
She faced a possible wait of up to two years and paid £20,000 for private treatment after losing faith.

tasks.prompt: Summarise why clinicians and officials are considering a national or regional endometriosis service for Wales.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לקשר בין דרישות ההסמכה, מחסור בתיאטרון ובצוותים, פערי מימון, הסיכון להעברת מטופלות לאנגליה והצורך במודל בר־קיימא.
expected_points: Complex endometriosis requires coordinated multidisciplinary teams and sufficient operating-theatre time.
Current health-board arrangements do not reliably fund protected staff time or enough operations to meet accreditation thresholds.
Centres risk downgrading, staff loss or closure, which could send patients to England at higher cost.
A national or regional commissioning model could pool resources and create a more sustainable service across Wales.

tasks.prompt: Why can minimum annual operation thresholds both support quality and create pressure on under-resourced centres?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר שהיקף ניתוחים מינימלי שומר על ניסיון ומיומנות, אך מחסור בזמן חדר ניתוח מונע מהמנתחים להגיע לסף ועלול לגרום לאובדן הסמכה ושירות.
expected_points: Performing enough procedures helps specialist surgeons maintain experience and competence.
Accreditation uses volume thresholds as a quality safeguard.
Limited theatre capacity can prevent individual surgeons from reaching the required number even when patients need care.
Failure to meet the threshold may remove accreditation, worsening access and encouraging skilled staff to leave.

tasks.prompt: Write a concise policy recommendation based on the evidence in the article.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציע מימון בר־קיימא ושירות אזורי או לאומי, זמן מוגן לצוות רב־תחומי וקיבולת חדרי ניתוח, תוך שמירה על הסמכה וצמצום המתנות.
expected_points: Recommend nationally or regionally commissioned specialist endometriosis care.
Provide sustainable funding for workforce, training, facilities and protected multidisciplinary time.
Increase theatre capacity so surgeons can treat patients and meet accreditation requirements.
Monitor waiting times, service continuity and the need to send patients outside Wales.
